tex_content.label: sec:symmetric-operators
tex_content.source:
\label{sec:symmetric-operators}

Let $S:H\to H$ be bounded and symmetric, and set
\[
m:=\inf_{\substack{u\in H\\\|u\|=1}}(Su,u),
\qquad
M:=\sup_{\substack{u\in H\\\|u\|=1}}(Su,u).
\]
